sum: Digital Currency X Technology Inc. engages in digital asset management services in China and internationally. The company offers DexTrader, an on-chain derivatives aggregation trading platform that provides a unified trading gateway, data analytics, and execution capabilities for digital assets and on-chain mapped traditional financial assets. The company was formerly known as Chijet Motor Company, Inc. and changed its name to Digital Currency X Technology Inc. in November 2025. Digital Currency X Technology Inc. was founded in 2009 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
